documents.text: Crane idle hours measure time waiting for work. Maintenance downtime is excluded. Work reference links operations records to berth assignments.
Downtime records repairs when a crane cannot operate. The maintenance job code is MT42.
Hospital occupancy is occupied bed days divided by available bed days. Patient waiting time is a separate measure.
Hotel occupancy uses occupied room nights divided by available room nights. Cancellations are excluded from booking totals.
Net store sales subtract refunded transactions from gross sales. Sales are recorded in euros.
The inspection reference ZXQ917 belongs to compressor B. The equipment register lists installation dates.
Staff attendance lists employee work shifts and leave requests.
Electricity usage is measured in kilowatt hours from daily meter readings.
